chapter_theme: One song at Mulvai (முள்வாய்): before the quarrelling kin and Death who hides in the sky can take his life, the poet asks Murugan to enter his brief life with anklets, sacred thread and kadamba.

989.reading: The poet asks that before his life goes, while the sons born of women quarrel among their own and speak against each other, Death hides in the sky, and the body wastes on earth knowing its day has come, Murugan, wearing golden anklets, thandai, the sacred thread and kadamba, enter his brief life as honey dwells in unfeigning hearts. The praise names Vishnu, the cloud who gives the heavenly world to devotees and lies on the serpent, and ends at Mulvai, where women whose bodies are bent like Kama's cane bow come to worship.
989.nuance: The plea sets the quarrel of heirs beside the approach of Death (விண்மேல் நமன் கரந்து), the family already dividing what the dying man leaves. பொய்யார் மனங்கள் தங்கும் மதுபோல: Murugan is asked to enter as he stays in true hearts. The last quatrain and the lines on Vishnu are hard to divide.

links.note: Thiruppugazh 989 places Death hidden in the sky (விண்மேல் நமன் கரந்து) while the body wastes and the heirs quarrel. Naladiyar 20 warns that merciless Death roams looking for his men and bids the reader keep his stealth in mind (அதன் கள்ளம் கடைப்பிடித்தல் நன்று). Both picture Death as concealed and watching, the Naladiyar to urge provision in time, the song to ask Murugan to come before life goes.
